exact_final_generation_prompt:
Create one sophisticated luxury-fashion visualization of a Footwear. Identity contract: A load-bearing woven or interlaced leather-strip lattice creates directional flexibility and support as an authentic part of the footwear structure. The functional monk strap remains continuous with and structurally integrated into the interlaced lattice. The product remains footwear and recognizably uses a functional adjustable monk-strap closure. The lattice must carry or transfer structural load and connect credibly to the shoe chassis; it cannot be a printed, embossed, appliqued, or decorative overlay. Approved redesign: Use a graded lattice at the instep and quarters with controlled anchor points into a refined solid sole, leaving calmer toe and heel fields. Graduate from a tighter structural weave near the strap and instep to larger, quieter cells toward transition zones. Use an elongated narrow last, low sculpted heel, and disciplined sole thickness with deliberate negative space. Make Onyx calfskin dominant; reserve linen and Butter Yellow for tension-bearing interlaces and precise touchpoint accents. Express strong proportions, material credibility, controlled novelty, intentional color, visual hierarchy, restraint, and plausible premium execution. The structural mechanism must remain operative and recognizable, never a decorative imitation. Do not change category, merge concepts, substitute a conventional product, or claim validated manufacturability or commercial readiness. One coherent product; no logos or text.
Variation 1 — architectural_clarity: Make the evaluated mechanism immediately legible through a disciplined, architectural silhouette and controlled luxury proportions.
Render one coherent product only, with no logos, captions, or text.
